name: mermaid-direct-edit
description: Edit Mermaid diagrams (Wardley maps, flowcharts) directly in the rendered drawing in Obsidian; renders with a pinned, current Mermaid

scripts.postbuild: obs plugin:reload id=mermaid-direct-edit >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'mermaid-direct-edit reloaded' || echo 'Note: plugin not reloaded (needs Obsidian running and the obs CLI wrapper; reload it by hand)'

author: Peter Beck
